Overview

Plzeň is a city in with a population of 175,000. The birthplace of Pilsner beer, a charming West Bohemian city with a beautiful Gothic cathedral, historic brewery, and strong industrial heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
